# Scribed

Pseudonymous writing: free for humans, pennies for machines. Essays in three
tiers — fragments ($0.01), ensembles ($0.02), prose ($0.05) — plus the
author-defined Lexicon (39 terms; $0.25 full dataset snapshot) and Common
Cents (20 curated quotes; $0.01 full set), all gated by x402 micropayments
in USDC on Base. LitWit, a literary notary, witnesses SHA-256 fingerprints
of works ($0.05/attestation; verification free). No accounts, no API keys.

- Catalog (free): /essays
- x402 manifest (free): /.well-known/x402
- Agent guide: /skill.md
- Human reading (free): /read/{slug}
- Machine reading (paid): GET /essays/{slug} → 402 Payment Required, pay, retry with proof.
- Lexicon: /lexicon (free index), GET /lexicon/snapshot ($0.25 dataset)
- Common Cents: /common-cents (free page), GET /common-cents/full ($0.01)
- LitWit: POST /witness/attest ($0.05), GET /witness/verify?hash=… (free), GET /witness/log (free)
